## Overview

Document the MiniMax-M3 NVFP4 GB200 aggregated Dynamo + vLLM profile qualified in [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4281](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4281) (head `7aa70626`). Recipes for vLLM-served models live here since #61302, so this changes only `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.yaml`: a guide section plus the selector fields that make the command builder render the qualified GB200 worker command.

## Claims

- New guide section **GB200: InferenceX AgentX aggregated (Dynamo + vLLM)**:
  - the six tested points (TP4 on one tray, TP8 across two trays) with `--max-num-seqs` and CUDA graph capture sizes
  - etcd and NATS services, and the worker environment, including the `mnnvl` all-reduce backend for TP8
  - the `python3 -m dynamo.vllm` worker command with the GQA EAGLE3 draft
  - SimpleCPUOffload host KV offload for the higher-concurrency points
  - the Dynamo frontend with the KV-aware router and session affinity
- It builds on the existing NVFP4 section's attention and draft settings rather than repeating their rationale.
- **Selector (command builder):**
  - `meta.hardware.gb200: verified` (end-to-end InferenceX run below) and `meta.default_variant.gb200: nvfp4`.
  - `variants.nvfp4.hardware_overrides.gb200`: the pinned nightly image, `--enable-prefix-caching`, `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`, `--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune`, `--stream-interval 20`, and `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE` / `NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE` / `NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE`.
  - `features.spec_decoding.modes.eagle3_gqa.hardware_overrides.gb200`: FlashInfer draft attention with `use_local_argmax_reduction`.
  - `strategy_overrides.multi_node_tp.hardware_overrides.gb200`: `VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND=mnnvl` for TP8 across two trays.
  - A guide pointer explaining which selections reproduce the profile.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` from vllm-project/recipes passes.
- The worker commands are the ones the InferenceX run launched (taken from its server logs), minus benchmark-only arguments: synthetic acceptance, config dumps and the duplicated served-model name. Image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-5555a2d8f7116b2b4877f66516f4128176cf722a`, Dynamo `1.6.0.dev20261016`.
- Rendered with `resolveCommand` (GB200, NVFP4, Spec Decoding → GQA, text-only, reasoning, tool calling):
  - Single-node TP renders `--tensor-parallel-size 4` with the qualified worker flags and env; Multi-node TP with 2 nodes renders TP8 (`--nnodes 2`, `--headless` follower) with `VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND=mnnvl`.
  - Compared with the run's TP4 and TP8 `dynamo.vllm` launch lines, every engine flag matches except per-point `--max-num-seqs` / `--compilation-config` capture sizes (in the guide table), Dynamo-only flags (`--request-plane`, `--kv-events-config`, `--dyn-*` parsers) and harness flags (synthetic acceptance, `--kv-cache-metrics`, config dumps). `--max-model-len 1048576` and `--pipeline-parallel-size 1` equal the defaults.
  - Every hardware/variant/strategy/spec-mode/KV-offload combination for the other hardware renders byte-identically to `main` (6,228 combinations). On GB200, the GQA draft override and the TP8 all-reduce env also apply to the other variants, since feature modes and strategy overrides cannot be scoped per variant.
- InferenceX sweep: [run 39150937290](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39150937290), attempt 1, all points green on the PR head.

## Details

Excluded as benchmark harness only:
- synthetic acceptance length
- AIPerf trace-replay settings
- Slurm and sbatch options, health checks and telemetry
- `ETCD_LEASE_TTL` and log-interval settings
- `kv-cache-metrics`

Loading timeouts are described rather than pinned. RDMA device selection (`UCX_NET_DEVICES`, `NCCL_IB_HCA`) is left to the deployment.

Selector limits, kept in the guide:
- per-concurrency `--max-num-seqs` and CUDA graph capture sizes;
- the Dynamo KV-router frontend and etcd/NATS services (the builder's Dynamo option exists only for `pd_cluster`);
- the exact SimpleCPUOffload budget (about 181 GiB per rank, lazy offload, `VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD=1`); the builder's **KV Offload → Simple** pill emits the same connector with its fixed default budget.

### Review follow-up (d8922cb1)

Addresses an independent render-based review:
- The builder keeps the current variant on a hardware switch, so the guide now says to pick **NVFP4** explicitly and gives deep links for TP4 and TP8; the ineffective `meta.default_variant.gb200` is dropped. The GB200 **Verified** badge is documented as NVFP4-only.
- Builder steps add **Text-only** (`--language-model-only`); TP8 adds `--headless` on node rank 1.
- Services: NATS with JetStream (as in the run), and `ETCD_ENDPOINTS` / `NATS_SERVER` for workers and frontend; frontend adds `DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp` and `DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=60`, names the `X-Dynamo-Session-ID` header, and notes the `--router-temperature` deprecation (FutureWarning in the run's frontend log).
- The **KV Offload → Simple** pill's fixed budget (220 GiB/rank, `lazy_offload: false`) is called out with the qualified replacement and `VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD=1`.
- Synthetic-acceptance disclosure (golden GQA AL 2.78) for the throughput points, the image digest, GB200 in the NVFP4 description, and YAML comments noting that the GB200 GQA and TP8 all-reduce overrides apply to every variant on GB200 (only NVFP4 was qualified).

Validation: `validate-source.mjs --source vllm` passes; renders are byte-identical to the previous head (guide/comments/metadata only) and differ from `main` only on GB200 (756 of 44,352 renders); the TP4 and TP8 deep-link selections render every qualified engine flag.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

   description: "MiniMax M3 vision-language MoE (427B total / 26B active) for frontier coding, agent toolchains, and 1M-token reasoning via MSA sparse attention — native multimodal (image + video + computer use); BF16 plus MXFP8, NVIDIA Blackwell NVFP4, and AMD MI355X MXFP4 variants. +          # only NVFP4 was qualified.

+              - "--speculative-config"
+              - '{"method": "eagle3", "model": "Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "attention_backend": "FLASHINFER", "use_local_argmax_reduction": true}'

     extra_args:

@@ -224,6 +235,25 @@ variants:
     extra_env:
       VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION: "high"
       VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND: "trtllm"
+    hardware_overrides:
+      # GB200 AgentX lane (InferenceX #4281, run 39150937290): one tray per TP4
+      # worker, two trays for TP8. Per-concurrency --max-num-seqs and CUDA
+      # graph sizes are in the guide.
+      gb200:

+        extra_args:

+          - "20"

     model_id: "amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4"

@@ -275,6 +305,14 @@ hardware_overrides:
       VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS: "1"
 
 strategy_overrides:
+  multi_node_tp:
+    hardware_overrides:
+      # TP8 across two GB200 trays all-reduces over MNNVL. Strategy overrides
+      # can't be scoped to a variant, so this applies to every variant on
+      # GB200; only NVFP4 was qualified.
+      gb200:
+        extra_env:
+          VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND: "mnnvl"
   pd_cluster:
     hardware_overrides:
       blackwell:
@@ -739,6 +777,85 @@ guide: |
   --speculative-config '{"method":"eagle3","model":"Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"FLASHINFER","use_local_argmax_reduction":true}'
   ```
 
+  ## GB200: InferenceX AgentX aggregated (Dynamo + vLLM)
+
+  The GB200 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm3-fp4-gb200-dynamo-vllm-agentic-agg-mtp`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4281](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4281)) serves the NVFP4 checkpoint with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three speculative tokens) as one aggregated vLLM worker behind the Dynamo frontend's KV-aware router. TP4 runs on one 4-GPU GB200 tray; TP8 spans two trays. Image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-5555a2d8f7116b2b4877f66516f4128176cf722a@sha256:8896fd7b29fc4ee7ce839f146cb4757984c476ec79d0234ffa8c995dee6e339a`, Dynamo `1.6.0.dev20261016` (`pip install ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261016`).
+
+  In the command builder, pick **GB200** and the **NVFP4** variant (the builder keeps the current variant when you switch hardware, so select NVFP4 explicitly), turn on **Spec Decoding → GQA** and **Text-only**, and use **Single-node TP** for TP4 or **Multi-node TP** with 2 nodes for TP8. That renders the worker flags and environment below as a `vllm serve` command. Direct links: [TP4](https://recipes.vllm.ai/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3?hardware=gb200&variant=nvfp4&features=tool_calling,reasoning,spec_decoding,text_only&fmode=spec_decoding:eagle3_gqa&strategy=single_node_tp) and [TP8 on two trays](https://recipes.vllm.ai/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3?hardware=gb200&variant=nvfp4&features=tool_calling,reasoning,spec_decoding,text_only&fmode=spec_decoding:eagle3_gqa&strategy=multi_node_tp&nodes=2). The GB200 **Verified** badge applies to this NVFP4 profile only; the GQA draft and TP8 all-reduce overrides also apply to the other variants on GB200, which were not qualified.
+
+  For the host-KV-offload points, don't use the **KV Offload → Simple** pill as is: its budget is fixed at 220 GiB per rank (880 GiB per 4-GPU tray) with `lazy_offload: false`, which is more host memory than a GB200 tray can give KV blocks. Replace its `--kv-transfer-config` with the qualified one below and set `VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD=1`. The per-concurrency settings in this table, the Dynamo KV-router frontend and its services stay in this guide.
+
+  | Clients | TP | `--max-num-seqs` | Host KV offload | CUDA graph capture sizes |
+  |---:|---:|---:|---|---|
+  | 1 | 4 | 2 | none | `1,2,4,8` |
+  | 1 | 8 | 2 | none | `1,2,4,8` |
+  | 10 | 4 | 16 | none | `1,2,4` then every 4 up to `64` |
+  | 20 | 4 | 8 | SimpleCPUOffload | every 4 from `4` to `32` |
+  | 25 | 4 | 16 | SimpleCPUOffload | every 4 from `4` to `64` |
+  | 30 | 4 | 45 | SimpleCPUOffload | every 4 from `4` to `180` |
+
+  Every list ends with `256,512,1024,2048` and uses `{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[...]}`. Sizes 1 and 2 give the drafter's decode steps full CUDA graphs at concurrency 1.
+
+  The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden EAGLE3-GQA acceptance length (2.78 for MiniMax-M3 with three draft tokens, thinking on; [`minimaxm3_eagle3_gqa.yaml`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/golden_al_distribution/minimaxm3_eagle3_gqa.yaml)) so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. Production serving keeps the default rejection sampler, as in the command below; the lane's accuracy evals ran that way.
+
+  ### Services and environment
+
+  Start etcd and NATS (JetStream on, 32 MB max payload) once:
+
+  ```bash
+  etcd --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 --advertise-client-urls http://<infra-host>:2379
+  printf 'max_payload: 33554432\njetstream {}\n' > nats.conf && nats-server -c nats.conf
+  ```
+
+  On every worker tray (and on the frontend host, point the same two variables at the services):
+
+  ```bash
+  export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://<infra-host>:2379 NATS_SERVER=nats://<infra-host>:4222
+  export VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND=trtllm
+  export NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1 NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1
+  export UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE=n UCX_TLS=cuda_copy,cuda_ipc,rc
+  ```
+
+  Set `UCX_NET_DEVICES` and `NCCL_IB_HCA` to the node's RDMA devices. For TP8 across two trays, use `VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND=mnnvl` instead of `trtllm`. Loading the 1M-context engine takes a while, so raise `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S` and `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` well above their defaults.
+
+  ### Worker
+
+  ```bash
+  python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 --served-model-name nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 \
+    --request-plane tcp --device-ids 0,1,2,3 \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 4 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 --trust-remote-code \
+    --attention-config '{"backend":"FLASHINFER","use_trtllm_attention":true,"indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8","minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend":"cutlass"}' \
+    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --block-size 128 --enable-prefix-caching \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"eagle3","model":"Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"FLASHINFER","use_local_argmax_reduction":true}' \
+    --max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-num-seqs <S> \
+    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[<sizes from the table>,256,512,1024,2048]}' \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune --stream-interval 20 --language-model-only \
+    --kv-events-config '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://*:5200"}' \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 --dyn-reasoning-parser minimax_m3 --dyn-tool-call-parser minimax_m3
+  ```
+
+  For TP8, run the same command on both trays with `--tensor-parallel-size 8 --nnodes 2 --node-rank <0|1> --master-addr <first-tray-ip>`, adding `--headless` on node rank 1.
+
+  For the host-KV-offload points, also set `VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD=1` and add:
+
+  ```bash
+  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"SimpleCPUOffloadConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"cpu_bytes_to_use":777389080576,"cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank":194347270144,"lazy_offload":true}}'
+  ```
+
+  That gives each of the four ranks about 181 GiB of pinned host memory for KV blocks.
+
+  ### Frontend
+
+  ```bash
+  export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://<infra-host>:2379 NATS_SERVER=nats://<infra-host>:4222 DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp
+  export DYN_TOKENIZER=fastokens DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8589934592 DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=60
+  python3 -m dynamo.frontend --trust-remote-code \
+    --router-mode kv --router-kv-events --router-temperature 0 \
+    --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 14400 --kv-cache-block-size 128
+  ```
+
+  The KV router uses the workers' KV events to send each request to the worker holding its prefix, and session affinity keeps a conversation on that worker: send a stable conversation ID in the `X-Dynamo-Session-ID` request header. This Dynamo build warns that `--router-temperature` is deprecated and will be removed in v1.7; newer builds take `router_temperature` in the default policy parameters of `--router-policy-config`.
+
   ## Quantized Variant (MXFP4 on MI355X)
 
   [`amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4`](https://huggingface.co/amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4)
